subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knows where their stuff is: in the chest in Ilvara’s room, and the Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself.
source_quote: I know where our stuff is. It’s in the chest in Ilvara’s room. The Drow leader probably keeps all the loot for herself. And if any other Drow had our stuff, they would taunt us.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz remembers that Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool, and that’s how the waste gets processed.
source_quote: Right, Sethir said there is a grey ooze in the pool. That’s how the waste gets processed.
